behaviour_established_from_source: file.c kissat_open_to_read_file / kissat_open_to_write_file: popen() is used ONLY when the path has suffix .bz2/.gz/.lzma/.7z/.xz/.Z (read side additionally requires the magic signature); every other path is opened in place with fopen(path, "r") or fopen(path, "w"). fopen("w") on an existing FIFO opens it in place (no unlink/recreate). The only unlink is for a '.7z' write path. The pilot uses '.cnf' inputs and a '.proof.fifo' proof path.
application.c write_proof: the proof is binary unless the path is '-' or --no-binary is given; the help text says the same ('For real files the binary proof format is used unless --no-binary').

application.c: the only other file output is the DIMACS output path of option -o/--output (not used); '-f' allows writing a proof to a path that looks like an existing CNF file and reading compressed files without decompression.
application.c: with no result kissat prints 's UNKNOWN'.
allocate.c/error.c: allocation failure prints 'kissat: fatal error: out-of-memory ...' to stderr.
